Lena R: Quick heads-up 1 QBR appendix: we need a 3-slide 'cost posture' mini for onboarding accounts that show renewal friction risk. Focus: token trends, forecasted runway, and 2 tactical mitigations. Owners?
Omar H: I can take AtlasPark. Will pull 30/60 token burn + recent spikes.
Maya C: I'll take Brightlane and check embed job patterns.
Eli J: I'll run a QPS x seq-length sensitivity and a cheap quantization estimate. ETA Wed EOD.
Lena R: Nice. Keep each slide to one chart + one action (throttle/credits/enable cache). Also include a single-line exec takeaway.
Maya C: For Brightlane, their nightly full-embed rebuild looks suspect. I'll quantify impact and propose incremental + shard window.
Omar H: AtlasPark has a handful of long-context debug calls. Suggest capping to 2k tokens for non-admin routes.
Eli J: Using the sim tool: 
```
./tools/spend_estimator --acct BRIGHTLANE --horizon 30 --qps 25,50 --lens 256,1024,2048 --quantize --out brightlane-sim.csv
```
Lena R: Add renewal-risk flag: "red" if 1) MoM burn up >40% AND 2) projected runout < 21 days. "Amber" if one condition true.
Maya C: Also propose a one-time buffer offer: $2,500 credit if they accept a 10-day optimization pilot. Legal OK?
Lena R: Legal pre-approved small pilot credits up to $3k. Use $2.5k as standard for onboarding.
Eli J: Uploaded sims: https://drive.redwood/ops/costs/brightlane-sim.csv and atlaspark-sim.csv. Key takeaway: Brightlane 50qps@2048 ~ $2.1k/day unquantized, quantized ~28% saving.
Omar H: Can Data team grant read to omar.h@redwood on atlaspark-billing.csv so I can pull raw events?
OpsBot: access granted to omar.h@redwood for project atlaspark-billing.csv
Maya C: Drafting the enablement blurb now. Short version: "We've spotted a spike driven by nightly embed rebuilds and long-context retries. Quick wins: 1) switch to incremental rebuilds 2) cap non-admin contexts 3) enable model quantization for batch jobs. We can apply one-time credit to kick off a 10-day pilot."
Lena R: Perfect. Deliverables: AtlasPark=Omar, Brightlane=Maya, Sensitivity=Eli, Enablement blurb=Lena. Due Tue 3pm PT so I can paste into QBR deck Wed morning.
Eli J: Will also attach a tiny CSV with QPS x seq matrix for quick reference.
Omar H: If any of the sims show >50% of spend from embeddings, flag for immediate throttle and manual CS outreach.
Maya C: Agree. I'll add a recommended throttle preset JSON snippet for the ops runbook.
Lena R: Great. If blockers on data or sims, ping here asap. I'll run a 20m dry-run Wed 4pm PT. :eyes:
